diff --git a/spans/merge.py b/spans/merge.py
index 258d39e..3a8a4f4 100644
--- a/spans/merge.py
+++ b/spans/merge.py
@@ -6,4 +6,22 @@ Contract: result is sorted, non-overlapping, and TOUCHING intervals merge
 
 
 def merge(intervals: list) -> list:
-    return sorted(intervals)
+    # Drop empty spans and sort by start, then end.
+    non_empty = [iv for iv in intervals if iv[0] < iv[1]]
+    non_empty.sort(key=lambda iv: (iv[0], iv[1]))
+
+    merged = []
+    for interval in non_empty:
+        if not merged:
+            merged.append(interval)
+            continue
+
+        last = merged[-1]
+        # Half-open [start, end): touching intervals (last.end == current.start)
+        # merge into one. Overlapping intervals also merge.
+        if interval[0] <= last[1]:
+            merged[-1] = (last[0], max(last[1], interval[1]))
+        else:
+            merged.append(interval)
+
+    return merged
